description: Oxfordshire County Council Highway Programmes of Work 2017-2018 is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Oxfordshire County Council. The data shows the planned programme of works which Oxfordshire County Council plan to carry out on the Highway network in 2017-18. Coverage: Oxfordshire County Council. The portal files it under the publisher Oxfordshire County Council. The portal shows 2026-07-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
